title: Audit and remediation for dense hybrid widgets: keyboard mapping and contrast token ramp
creator: Liam O'Rourke
description: Background: Several product monitoring dashboards use a compact, combined 'hybrid' widget that contains a sparkline chart, a sortable table, and inline filters/actions. These widgets are dense (small type, tightly packed controls) and have started failing automated a11y checks: low text/element contrast at 14px, inconsistent tab order between table rows and chart points, and unclear ARIA mapping for interactive chart elements (SVG points + canvas overlays). Goal: produce an actionable remediation plan covering contrast token adjustments, focused keyboard/tab order conventions for hybrid widgets, ARIA role/label mappings for chart points and table rows, and a VPAT evidence annex for the impacted components. Deliverables: 1) token ramp proposal with examples at 14px and 12px; 2) keyboard/tab flow spec and canonical focus state visuals; 3) ARIA mapping table for chart+table interactive elements; 4) design QA checklist + test harness links; 5) VPAT annex draft and evidence artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Contrast token ramp documented and applied to widget previews; new tokens meet WCAG AA at 14px and AA/AAA where feasible for emphasis
Canonical keyboard flow documented: tab order, arrow key handling inside charts, skip-to-table affordance, escape/back behavior
ARIA mapping table that assigns roles, labels, and live-region announcements for chart points, series legends, filters, and interactive table rows
Design patterns reviewed and signed off by Accessibility lead and one PM; implementation PRs referenced in ticket
VPAT annex contains screenshots, accessibility test results, and reviewer signoffs for the hybrid widget family
steps: Run component-level a11y audit across all hybrid widget instances (console dashboards, alerts, reports)
Prototype token ramp variants in Figma and generate contrast snapshots for 12px/14px/16px contexts
Define keyboard/tab mapping: primary tab stops, internal arrow navigation, and tab-exit points to the next page element
Define ARIA roles and label strategy for chart points (aria-role=gridcell/listitem with aria-label backing), chart canvas (aria-hidden vs exposed overlays), and table rows
Ship a small CSS token patch and focused outline update behind a feature flag for early QA
Collect evidence (screenshots, axe/pa11y output, VoiceOver/VO recordings) and assemble VPAT annex
comments: 2026-02-25 - Liam O'Rourke: Initial triage completed. Ran axe against desktop and compact breakpoints. Primary failures: contrast (AA fail for body 14px against subtle-muted token), missing aria-labels for chart interactive points, and tab-order anomalies when table sorting is active. Added dependencies to ENG-4219 (runtime of table virtualization) and DES-803721 for related conformance work.

2026-03-02 - Maya Chen: Uploaded first-pass token ramp in Figma. Documented three variants: 'Neutral+', 'Neutral++', 'Emphasis-high'. Neutral+ meets AA at 14px for body copy; Emphasis-high targets interactive controls. Leaving notes on token names that will affect CSS variable names (we should avoid deprecating existing tokens without migration path).

2026-03-05 - Accessibility Lead (Priya Rao): Feedback: prefer renaming 'Emphasis-high' to 'focusable-strong' and ensure focus outlines have 3:1 contrast on top of component backgrounds. Also requested keyboard-flow doc include explicit guidance for screen reader announcements when chart points are focused.

2026-03-08 - Engineering reviewer (Diego Patel): Noted implementation caveat: table virtualization (ENG-4219) reuses DOM nodes which affects stable aria-ids. Suggest implementing data-index-based aria-labels and adding a small debounce for live-region announcements. Will open an ENG PR for virtualization accessibility changes.

2026-03-11 - Maya Chen: Implemented Figma prototype for keyboard flow. Created annotated frames showing tab sequence: filter -> chart legend -> chart point (arrow to navigate) -> skip to table button -> table header -> table row (enter to open details). Posted Figma link in attachments.

2026-03-13 - QA (Jordan Kim): Ran VoiceOver walkthrough on macOS and NVDA on Windows. VoiceOver announced chart points inconsistently when arrow navigation used; NVDA exposed missing aria-rowindex on table rows. Added two new items to acceptance criteria and suggested adding automated CI axe checks that run on the token patch branch.

2026-03-14 - Liam O'Rourke: Draft VPAT annex started in Drive folder. Collected initial screenshots and axe outputs. Scheduling design+engineering review on 2026-03-18 to align on implementation scope and rollout behind feature flag. Updated due_date to 2026-03-28 to allow for a follow-up round of QA and VPAT signoff.
notes: Implementation should be behind experimental feature flag 'hybrid-widget-a11y-2026' to allow gradual rollout and telemetry collection
We must coordinate token renames with design-tokens team to avoid breaking downstream projects; propose a migration deprecation window of two releases
Consider adding a small 'skip to table' control for keyboard users that collapses/hides when not focused
Add unit tests that assert contrast ratios for CSS variables using the same snapshot tool used in design token CI
